arxiv-1906-11401.title: Quantum Phase Estimation with Time-Frequency Qudits in a Single Photon
arxiv-1906-11401.creator: Hsuan-Hao Lu, Zixuan Hu, Mohammed S. Alshaykh, Alexandria J. Moore, Yuchen Wang, Poolad Imany, Andrew M. Weiner, Sabre Kais
arxiv-1906-11401.description: Abstract The Phase Estimation Algorithm (PEA) is an important quantum algorithm used independently or as a key subroutine in other quantum algorithms. Currently most implementations of the PEA are based on qubits, where the computational units in the quantum circuits are two-dimensional states.

arxiv-2106-05193.title: A Hybrid APM-CPGSO Approach for Constraint SatisfactionProblem Solving: Application to Remote Sensing
arxiv-2106-05193.creator: Zouhayra Ayadi, Wadii Boulila, Imed Riadh Farah
arxiv-2106-05193.description: Abstract Constraint satisfaction problem (CSP) has been actively used for modeling and solving a wide range of complex real-world problems. However, it has been proven that developing efficient methods for solving CSP, especially for large problems, is very difficult and challenging. Existing complete methods for problem-solving are in most cases unsuitable.

arxiv-2206-05309.title: EigenFairing: 3D Model Fairing using Image Coherence
arxiv-2206-05309.creator: Pragyana Mishra, Omead Amidi, and Takeo Kanade Robotics Institute, Carnegie Mellon University Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania 15213, USA
arxiv-2206-05309.description: Abstract A surface is often modeled as a triangulated mesh of 3D points and textures associated with faces of the mesh. The 3D points could be either sampled from range data or derived from a set of images using a stereo or Structure-from-Motion algorithm.

arxiv-2309-13128.title: Emergent inflation of the Efimov spectrum under three-body spin-exchange interactions
arxiv-2309-13128.creator: J. van de Kraats, D. J. M. Ahmed-Braun, J.-L. Li, S. J. J. M. F. Kokkelmans
arxiv-2309-13128.description: Abstract We resolve the unexpected and long-standing disagreement between experiment and theory in the Efimovian three-body spectrum of 7 Li, commonly referred to as the lithium few-body puzzle. Our results show that the discrepancy arises out of the presence of strong non-universal three-body spin-exchange interactions, which enact an effective inflation of the universal Efimov spectrum.

arxiv-2312-11706.title: Some Fibonacci-Related Sequences
arxiv-2312-11706.creator: Benoit Cloitre, Jeffrey Shallit
arxiv-2312-11706.description: Abstract We discuss an interesting sequence defined recursively; namely, sequence A105774 from the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences , and study some of its properties. Our main tools are Fibonacci representation, finite automata, and the Walnut theorem-prover. We also prove two new results about synchronized sequences.

arxiv-2403-12706.title: AnimateDiff-Lightning: Cross-Model Diffusion Distillation
arxiv-2403-12706.creator: Shanchuan Lin, Xiao Yang
arxiv-2403-12706.description: Abstract We present AnimateDiff-Lightning for lightning-fast video generation. Our model uses progressive adversarial diffusion distillation to achieve new state-of-the-art in few-step video generation. We discuss our modifications to adapt it for the video modality. Furthermore, we propose to simultaneously distill the probability flow of multiple base diffusion models, resulting in a single distilled motion module with broader style compatibility.

arxiv-2404-08078.title: SQBC: Active Learning using LLM-Generated Synthetic Data for Stance Detection in Online Political Discussions
arxiv-2404-08078.creator: Stefan Sylvius Wagner, Maike Behrendt, Marc Ziegele, Stefan Harmeling
arxiv-2404-08078.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Stefan Sylvius Wagner, Maike Behrendt, Marc Ziegele, Stefan Harmeling. Stance detection is an important task for many applications that analyse or support online political discussions. Common approaches include fine-tuning transformer based models. However, these models require a large amount of labelled data, which might not be available.

pmc-10579815.title: Bioconcentration of carbamazepine, enalapril, and sildenafil in neotropical fish species
pmc-10579815.creator: Macarena Gisele Rojo, Diego Cristos, Pedro Carriquiriborde
pmc-10579815.description: Sewage effluents are the main source of entry of Human Pharmaceutical Active Ingredients (HPAIs) to surface water bodies. Carbamazepine (CBZ), psychiatric drug, enalapril (ENA) antihypertensive, and sildenafil (SIL), to treat erectile dysfunction, have been frequently detected in receiving wastewater and in wild fish species from Argentina.

pmc-11324726.title: Structural dynamics of protein-protein association involved in the light-induced transition of Avena sativa LOV2 protein
pmc-11324726.creator: Changin Kim, So Ri Yun, Sang Jin Lee, Seong Ok Kim, Hyosub Lee, Jungkweon Choi, Jong Goo Kim, Tae Wu Kim, Seyoung You, Irina Kosheleva, Taeyoon Noh, Jonghoon Baek, Hyotcherl Ihee
pmc-11324726.description: The Light-oxygen-voltage-sensing domain (LOV) superfamily, found in enzymes and signal transduction proteins, plays a crucial role in converting light signals into structural signals, mediating various biological mechanisms. While time-resolved spectroscopic studies have revealed the dynamics of the LOV-domain chromophore’s electronic structures, understanding the structural changes in the protein moiety, particularly regarding light-induced dimerization, remains challenging.

pmc-11616423.title: Chorea in Hemodialysis Patients: Report of Two Cases
pmc-11616423.creator: Xiaoxia Chen, Yafeng Zhang, Yue Zhou
pmc-11616423.description: BackgroundChorea is rare in maintenance dialysis patients but seriously affects the quality of life, and there are few previous reports of this condition. We report two patients undergoing regular hemodialysis for end-stage renal disease, both of whom presented with progressively intensified involuntary limb movements, but originating from different etiologies.

pmc-12689972.title: Balanced multi-electrolyte solution versus normal saline for fluid therapy in aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage: an influence on fluid and electrolytes balance and outcome
pmc-12689972.creator: Yu-Qing Duan, Ying Tian, Shuya Wang, Shan-Shan Xu, Ming-Yue Miao, Ran Gao, Rui Su, Mengxue Hou, Yuqing Chen, Zimeng Xu, Linlin Zhang, Jian-Xin Zhou
pmc-12689972.description: IntroductionIsotonic crystalloids are commonly used for maintaining fluid balance and cerebral perfusion pressure in critical care patients with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage (aSAH). However, the relatively high concentration of chloride in normal saline (NS) might lead to hyperchloremia or acute kidney injury, comparing with multi-electrolyte solutions (BMES).

pmc-12721542.title: Identification of diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers for tuberculosis based on plasma proteomics
pmc-12721542.creator: Yan Hu, Chao Quan, Yuanyuan Zhou, Shangyan Liang, Xuan Wang, Jun Li, Wenqi Liu, Yuzhong Xu, Peng Liu
pmc-12721542.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe differential diagnosis between Tuberculosis (TB) and Non-tuberculous Mycobacteria (NTM) has historically been constrained by the inadequate sensitivity and specificity of current diagnostic methods. Furthermore, distinguishing between Active Tuberculosis (ATB) and Latent Tuberculosis Infection (LTBI) poses significant challenges.

pmc-13180812.title: Associations between aggregate index of systemic inflammation and endometriosis risk utilizing logistic regression analysis
pmc-13180812.creator: Jing Chen, Kaiqiang Xu, Yanyan Xing, Songping Liu, Lijuan Lu
pmc-13180812.description: ObjectiveSystemic inflammatory response plays a key role in the pathogenesis of endometriosis. This study aimed to investigate the association between the aggregate index of systemic inflammation (AISI), defined as neutrophil count × platelet count × monocyte count/lymphocyte count, and the risk of endometriosis, and to develop a predictive nomogram incorporating AISI.

pmc-13329763.title: Bladder Melanosis: Clinicopathologic Insights Into a Rare Mimic of Malignant Melanoma
pmc-13329763.creator: Mukund Tinguria
pmc-13329763.description: Melanosis of the urinary bladder (melanosis vesicae) is a rare condition where dark, velvety patches are seen on the bladder mucosa during cystoscopy. With fewer than 30 cases reported to date, it remains an exceptionally rare finding. The condition is often associated with symptoms like urinary urgency or incontinence.
